item.title: Open Source State of the Union
item.description: Making big investments in open source software? We thought so. 2024 has been a tumultuous year for open source projects with relicensing, un-relicensing, and other adventures. Our panel of in-the-trenches experts will opine on what’s going well for users, what are the current trainwrecks, and what’s plain fun to watch. Get tips to protect your existing apps and see new opportunities. Best of all, we’ll talk about how you can make open source work better for everyone.
